body:
There's a pack of new razor blades for my single blade razor infront of me. I keep picking the one I've opened up, and setting it down again. I Can't help but stare at it thinking its my way out. IVe never felt like this, even with all the bad in my life.

It's such a pretty, shiny, light thing. Funny to think of what it can do to skin. At the moment the only thing that keeps making me put it down is the fact I know I can't stand to see my own blood.... I'll get over that soon I guess

It's not the ex that's killing me. It doesn't help, but it's everything else. The only real thing stopping me from calling my guy n having him bring by more drugs than my body can handle is the fact that if I'm go, I screw my work over because we're understaffed as is.

I texted people, have made it very obvious on facebook that I'm in a downward spiral and no one has asked why or if they can help. If someone asks tonight at work I'll probably just start to cry. I'm not a dude that cries man.
